mentions.name: gamepass.fyi
mentions.description: This web app makes it easy to compare Xbox Game Pass tiers (Essential vs Premium) so users can pick the cheaper tier that fits their needs and save a few bucks. Since there is no API for the 'Leaving Soon' list, it uses a scraper whose content is parsed through an LLM call and matched to games. It includes a swipe mechanism to favorite or trash games, keeping the tier comparison uncluttered by titles like FIFA or CoD. Hosted at https://gamepass.fyi.
mentions.problem: It is hard to see the difference between Xbox Game Pass tiers to know whether you only need Essential or Premium, and there is no API for the Leaving Soon list.
mentions.audience: Gamers deciding which Xbox Game Pass subscription tier they need.
mentions.source_excerpt: Wanted to make it easy to see the difference between the Xbox Gamepass tiers, maybe you only need essential or premium - saving a few bucks. With Claude it's been pretty fun to add new features. Since there's no API for Leaving Soon I built a scraper, content gets parsed through an LLM call and matched to games. There's a swipe mechanism to favorite or trash games, so you comparison doesn't get cluttered up by fifa's or cod's. It's just been a fun playground, I host it on https://gamepass.fyi
